problems.name: HumanEval_108_count_nums
problems.code:
def count_nums(arr)
  arr.count do |num|
    digits = num.to_s.chars
    if digits.first == '-'
      # For negative numbers, make the first digit negative
      digits[1..-1] = digits[1..-1].map(&:to_i)
      digits[0] = -digits[0].to_i
    else
      digits = digits.map(&:to_i)
    end
    
    sum = digits.sum
    sum > 0
  end
end


require 'test/unit'
class TestHumanEval < Test::Unit::TestCase
  def test_count_nums
    candidate = method(:count_nums)
    assert_equal(0, candidate.call([]))
    assert_equal(0, candidate.call([-1, -2, 0]))
    assert_equal(6, candidate.call([1, 1, 2, -2, 3, 4, 5]))
    assert_equal(5, candidate.call([1, 6, 9, -6, 0, 1, 5]))
    assert_equal(4, candidate.call([1, 100, 98, -7, 1, -1]))
    assert_equal(5, candidate.call([12, 23, 34, -45, -56, 0]))
    assert_equal(1, candidate.call([0, 1]))
    assert_equal(1, candidate.call([1]))
  end
end

problems.name: HumanEval_111_histogram
problems.code:
def histogram(test)
  return {} if test.empty?
  
  letters = test.split(' ')
  counts = Hash.new(0)
  
  letters.each { |letter| counts[letter] += 1 }
  
  max_count = counts.values.max
  result = {}
  
  counts.each do |letter, count|
    if count == max_count
      result[letter] = count
    end
  end
  
  result
end


require 'test/unit'
class TestHumanEval < Test::Unit::TestCase
  def test_histogram
    candidate = method(:histogram)
    assert_equal({"a" => 2, "b" => 2}, candidate.call("a b b a"))
    assert_equal({"a" => 2, "b" => 2}, candidate.call("a b c a b"))
    assert_equal({"a" => 1, "b" => 1, "c" => 1, "d" => 1, "g" => 1}, candidate.call("a b c d g"))
    assert_equal({"r" => 1, "t" => 1, "g" => 1}, candidate.call("r t g"))
    assert_equal({"b" => 4}, candidate.call("b b b b a"))
    assert_equal({"r" => 1, "t" => 1, "g" => 1}, candidate.call("r t g"))
    assert_equal({}, candidate.call(""))
    assert_equal({"a" => 1}, candidate.call("a"))
  end
end

def rounded_avg(n, m)
  return -1 if n > m
  
  sum = (n..m).sum
  count = m - n + 1
  average = (sum.to_f / count).round
  
  "0b#{average.to_s(2)}"
end

problems.name: HumanEval_146_specialFilter

def specialFilter(nums)
  count = 0
  odd_digits = Set.new([1, 3, 5, 7, 9])
  
  nums.each do |num|
    if num > 10
      first_digit = num.to_s.chars.first.to_i
      last_digit = num.to_s.chars.last.to_i
      
      if odd_digits.include?(first_digit) && odd_digits.include?(last_digit)
        count += 1
      end
    end
  end
  
  count
end

problems.name: HumanEval_87_get_row
problems.code:
def get_row(lst, x)
  result = []
  
  lst.each_with_index do |row, row_idx|
    row.each_with_index do |value, col_idx|
      if value == x
        result << [row_idx, col_idx]
      end
    end
  end
  
  # Sort by row ascending, then by column descending
  result.sort_by { |coord| [coord[0], -coord[1]] }
end


require 'test/unit'

  def test_get_row
    candidate = method(:get_row)
    assert_equal([[0, 0], [1, 4], [1, 0], [2, 5], [2, 0]], candidate.call([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 1]], 1))
    assert_equal([[0, 1], [1, 1], [2, 1], [3, 1], [4, 1], [5, 1]], candidate.call([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]], 2))
    assert_equal([[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 1], [2, 0], [3, 2], [3, 0], [4, 3], [4, 0], [5, 4], [5, 0], [6, 5], [6, 0]], candidate.call([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 1, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 1, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 1]], 1))

def search(lst)
  # Count frequency of each element
  freq = Hash.new(0)
  lst.each { |x| freq[x] += 1 }
  
  # Find maximum valid integer
  max_valid = -1
  freq.each do |num, count|
    if num <= count && num > max_valid

  end
  
  max_valid
end

problems.name: HumanEval_131_digits

def digits(n)
  product = 1
  has_odd = false
  
  while n > 0
    digit = n % 10
    if digit.odd?
      product *= digit
      has_odd = true
    end
    n /= 10
  end
  
  has_odd ? product : 0
end

def hex_key(num)
  primes = Set.new([2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13])
  count = 0
  
  num.each_char do |char|
    decimal_value = case char
                    when 'A' then 10
                    when 'B' then 11
                    when 'C' then 12
                    when 'D' then 13
                    when 'E' then 14
                    when 'F' then 15
                    else char.to_i
                    end
    
    count += 1 if primes.include?(decimal_value)
  end
  
  count
end

problems.name: HumanEval_18_how_many_times
problems.code:
def how_many_times(string, substring)
  return 0 if string.empty? || substring.empty?
  
  count = 0
  start = 0
  
  while start <= string.length - substring.length
    pos = string.index(substring, start)
    break unless pos
    
    count += 1
    start = pos + 1
  end
  
  count
end

  result = []

problems.code:
def is_prime(n)
  return false if n <= 1
  return true if n <= 3
  return false if n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0
  
  i = 5
  while i * i <= n

def get_closest_vowel(word)
  vowels = "aeiouAEIOU"
  # Start from the second last character and go backwards to the second character
  (word.length - 2).downto(1) do |i|
    char = word[i]
    prev_char = word[i-1]
    next_char = word[i+1]
    
    # Check if current character is a vowel
    if vowels.include?(char)
      # Check if previous and next characters are consonants
      if !vowels.include?(prev_char) && !vowels.include?(next_char)
        return char
      end
    end
  end
  
  ""
end

def is_sorted(lst)
  # Check if array has more than 1 duplicate of the same number
  counts = lst.group_by(&:itself).transform_values(&:count)
  return false if counts.any? { |_, count| count > 2 }
  
  # Check if array is sorted in ascending order
  (0...lst.length - 1).all? { |i| lst[i] <= lst[i + 1] }
end

problems.name: HumanEval_93_encode
problems.code:
def encode(message)
  vowels = 'aeiou'
  result = ''
  
  message.each_char do |char|
    if char.match?(/[a-z]/i)
      # Swap case
      swapped_case = char.swapcase
      
      # Replace vowels with letter 2 places ahead
      if vowels.include?(swapped_case.downcase)
        vowel_index = vowels.index(swapped_case.downcase)
        replacement_vowel = vowels[(vowel_index + 2) % vowels.length]
        
        # Preserve original case
        if swapped_case == swapped_case.upcase
          result += replacement_vowel.upcase
        else
          result += replacement_vowel
        end
      else
        result += swapped_case
      end
    else
      result += char
    end
  end
  
  result
end

  def test_encode

    assert_equal("tgst", candidate.call("TEST"))
    assert_equal("mWDCSKR", candidate.call("Mudasir"))
    assert_equal("ygs", candidate.call("YES"))
    assert_equal("tHKS KS C MGSSCGG", candidate.call("This is a message"))
    assert_equal("k dQnT kNqW wHcT Tq wRkTg", candidate.call("I DoNt KnOw WhAt tO WrItE"))
